subject: [PATCH v5 10/11] mm: install PMD swap entries on swap-out

reviews.author: Luiz Capitulino
reviews.summary: The reviewer suggested calling VM_WARN_ON_ONCE() and returning an error instead of installing a PMD swap entry in try_to_unmap_one(), as this function assumes that the PMD swap entry was installed, which is not the case.
reviews.raw_body:
Should we call VM_WARN_ON_ONCE() and return an error instead? This
function is only called by try_to_unmap_one() under this condition. In
addition, returning zero would cause try_to_unmap_one() to assume that
the PMD swap entry was installed, which is not the case.

2026-08-05.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the swap-out process for huge pages (Transparent Huge Pages, or THPs) by installing PMD-level swap entries instead of splitting them into individual PTEs. This reduces overhead and preserves the huge mapping across the swap round-trip. The patch mirrors the existing PTE swap-out path at PMD granularity, handling zswap and adjusting MM_ANONPAGES / MM_SWAPENTS accordingly. It also introduces a new counter, thp_swpout_pmd, to track PMD mappings replaced by PMD-level swap entries.
